study type: Case-control study nested within a cohort
outcome: insulin secretion (HOMA insulin secretion, insulinogenic index)
cohort: The study included 87 women with prior GDM and 45 controls with normal glucose tolerance during pregnancy, aged 22-44 years, drawn from a cohort of all deliveries at Saint Margit Hospital, Budapest, between 2005-2006.
finding: 25(OH)D levels were positively associated with HOMA insulin sensitivity, but prior GDM status was not associated with 25(OH)D levels.
